prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_FT_rf', seasonality_champion='ONLY_FT_rf', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ONLY_FT_rf dominates both trend (corr=1.0) and seasonality (corr=0.5285) pattern matching, while ONLY_FT_catboost achieves the lowest overall RMSE (96.95). However, the series shows high unpredictability (spectral_entropy=0.89) and unstable model rankings (Kendall=0.19), suggesting robust combiners like median or trimmed mean are preferable over weighted stacking to avoid overfitting noise.
